# attest module responsibility map

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-module-maps.mjs; DO NOT EDIT. -->

This file is derived only from `@responsibility` declarations in each source file header.

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `ac-parser.ts` | Parses story acceptance-criterion blocks into stable derived entries. |
| `ansi-html.ts` | Converts supported ANSI terminal formatting into safe HTML fragments. |
| `capture-bridge.ts` | Links completed browser operations to authoritative physical capture requests. |
| `capture-capabilities.ts` | Probes and atomically records honest capture-source capabilities. |
| `capture-planner.ts` | Plans and dispatches independent eligible acceptance-evidence capture lanes. |
| `capture-policy-migration.ts` | Migrates capture policy text safely between supported policy modes. |
| `contract-projection.ts` | Projects and hashes frozen acceptance contracts from story specifications. |
| `evidence-classifier.ts` | Classifies capture artifacts and rejects evidence that cannot satisfy visual criteria. |
| `evidence-drafter.ts` | Drafts conservative acceptance-evidence maps from recorded delivery signals. |
| `evidence-health.ts` | Resolves visual-evidence health independently from delivery correctness. |
| `evidence-repair.ts` | Reruns evidence capture without reopening a completed delivery build. |
| `execution-cast.ts` | Projects cycle role attempts into renderable execution-cast rows. |
| `gc.ts` | Decides which archived acceptance-report runs are safe to retain or delete. |
| `outward-smoke.ts` | Defines pure external smoke-run policy, redaction, and report logic. |
| `outward-verification.ts` | Evaluates outward verification declarations and their execution outcomes. |
| `report-smoke.ts` | Validates generated acceptance reports with deterministic smoke assertions. |
| `report.ts` | Renders acceptance evidence and delivery truth into standalone reports. |
| `serve-rendered-capture-v2.ts` | Serves rendered capture requests through the v2 evidence protocol. |
